note: Pins imported blocks per spec/decisions/0002-sram-source.md. Nothing is pinned unless listed here.

pins.name: sky130-sram-macro-1rw1r-32x1024-8
pins.role: target bank (4 KB, 1024 x 32); spec section 9
pins.generator: OpenRAM (VLSIDA); the pre-generated 2 KB macro's log reports v1.1.15. Generator commit NOT pinned: not yet generated here.
pins.views_note: No pre-generated 1024 x 32 macro exists at this commit. Verilog, LEF, GDS and Liberty views are NOT imported; they do not exist until the generator is run. Gaps G1, G2 stay open.

pins.name: sky130-sram-macro-1rw1r-32x512-8
pins.role: fallback bank (2 KB, 512 x 32); also the only macro Verilog the wrapper is checked against
pins.views_note: Only a TT 1.8 V 25 C Liberty view ships (common config sets nominal_corner_only = True). No slow or fast view exists: gaps G1 and G2 remain open.

pins.name: openram-toolchain
pins.role: generator toolchain for the OpenRAM macros (flow/sram/setup.sh); fetched into a scratch dir, nothing installed host-wide

sram_cells.note: The commit OpenRAM 1.2.50's own Makefile pins (SRAM_LIB_GIT_COMMIT). Holds the 2-port openram_dp_cell views (SPICE, GDS, LVS) that the worker's sky130A install lacks.

std_cell_views.note: Only cells/dlxtn/sky130_fd_sc_hd__dlxtn_1.{gds,spice} are used, as OpenRAM's make sky130-install does.

macro_configs.note: Same commit as the macro pins above; sky130_sram_common.py hash matches theirs.

pins.python_packages_note: Versions the probe was run with (CPython 3.12). PyPI wheel hashes are not pinned; pip verifies wheels against PyPI metadata only.
